### last time {.smaller}

*  locks, pthread lock API
   *  agree to acquire lock before accessing something shared
   *  ensures thread take turns accessing shared thing
      *  assuming everyone follows agreement
*  barriers
   *  wait for everyone else
   *  reusing
*  deadlock
   *  mutual exclusion + hold and wait + circular wait
   *  happening indeterminately and "by accident" with locks

# deadlock prevention {visibility="hidden"}

## techniques overview {visibility="hidden"}

### deadlock prevention techniques {.smaller}

<style>
.myprevent td { vertical-align: top; margin-bottom: 1em; }
</style>
<table class="myprevent">
<tr><td>
*  [<b>infinite resources</b>]{.myem-only .custom .fragment fragment-index=1}
   *  or at least enough that they never run out
</td>
<td>no mutual exclusion</td>
</tr>
<tr><td>
*  [<b>no shared resources</b>]{.myem-only .custom .fragment fragment-index=2}
</td>
<td>no mutual exclusion</td>
</tr>
<tr><td>
*  <b>no waiting</b>
   *  ["busy signal" --- abort and (maybe) retry]{.myem-only .custom .fragment fragment-index=3}
   *  revoke/preempt resources
</td>
<td>no hold and wait/preemption</td>
</tr>
<tr><td>
*  acquire resources in <b>consistent order</b>
</td>
<td>no hold and wait/preemption</td>
</tr>
<tr><td>
*  request <b>all resources at once</b>
</td>
<td>no hold and wait</td>
</tr>
</table>

### "busy signal"

*  example: malloc() fails rather than waiting
   *  no deadlock possible
*  problem: if retrying, how many times?
